accepted_boundary: For every odd prime p and primitive p^s-th root q with 3p<p^s: actual P_{3p} and H_{3p} are squarefree and the original ordinary-square bilinear CD kernel is nonzero at every P_{3p} root.

local_p_ge_5.roots: 2p roots of valuation (2p-1)/(2p), p-1 roots of valuation 1, and simple zero; the last p roots have pairwise distance valuation 1

p_3_scope: Only the squarefreeness and original kernel conclusions at b=9, uniformly for s>=3; no generic valuation or discriminant formula asserted.
preserve_prior_results: All accepted earlier ranges, including complete root-order d=9 and d=25 certificates and fixed-residual results
Accepted p-block, b=2p and third-block root descriptions and discriminant formulas on their stated ranges
The all-odd fixed-node guard and independently guarded local/all-A formulas
Original recurrence, H normalization, ordinary-square kernel, signed coefficients and nonzero-denominator requirements
Separate OPEN58 paired-support and OPEN53 endpoint obligations; all metric-route obstructions and ordinary-versus-q-discriminant distinctions
remaining: Ordinary squarefreeness and bilinear nonisotropy outside all accepted ranges, including later 3p<b<p^s degrees where not separately certified, and remaining odd-composite orders. Existing local/all-A formulas require every independent inherited guard.
exclusions: No unrestricted F020 or all-A closure
No p=3 generic root-valuation or discriminant-valuation formula
No historical originality claim or exhaustive literature search
No cost or algorithmic improvement claim
novelty_ranking: Unchanged; this mathematical acceptance does not establish historical priority.
